text.en: OK to use. CoinGecko and the factory both confirm this vault. To review holds the oracles that only the Morpho API lists, which AI checked on chain.
text.zh-TW: 可以用。CoinGecko 和工廠都確認這個 vault；待確認是只有 Morpho API 列出的 oracle，AI 在鏈上查過。

pastTxsConclusion.en: The windows found no submission by this vault. AI's own Etherscan query found 16 submission transactions in the year, too few for one-day windows to catch.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 取樣窗口沒找到這個 vault 的提交。AI 另查 Etherscan，這一年有 16 筆提交交易，一天長的窗口抓不到這麼少的交易。

text.en: This vault holds about 98 million USDC. 738 addresses hold shares; the largest has 11.51% and the top 10 hold 46.65%. Before 2026-02 it held only about 100,000 USDC; after that it stayed between 60 million and 124 million for the rest of the year.
text.zh-TW: 這個 vault 約 9,800 萬 USDC，738 個地址持有股份，最大一個占 11.51%，前 10 名占 46.65%。2026-02 前只有約 10 萬 USDC，之後一年都在 6,000 萬到 1.24 億之間。

recommendation.en: It is large, so raising a cap puts many depositors' funds into this market. Set the cap by your risk framework.
recommendation.zh-TW: 規模大，提高上限會讓很多存款人的錢進這個市場；上限照你的風險框架給。

text.en: This vault's timelock for both `increaseAbsoluteCap` and `increaseRelativeCap` is 7 days (`timelock` read on chain, 604800 seconds). For 7 days after it is sent, depositors can see this change, and the sentinel or curator can cancel it with `revoke`.
text.zh-TW: 這個 vault 的 `increaseAbsoluteCap` 和 `increaseRelativeCap` 的 timelock 都是 7 天（鏈上讀 `timelock`，604800 秒）：送出後 7 天內存款人看得到這個變更，sentinel 或 curator 可以用 `revoke` 取消。

recommendation.en: If you find a mistake within 7 days of sending, cancel it with `revoke`; do not wait for it to be executed.
recommendation.zh-TW: 送出後 7 天內發現填錯，用 `revoke` 取消，不要等它被執行。

role.zh-TW: Gauntlet 管理的 USDC vault（V2，USDC Prime），你是它的 curator

text.en: Gauntlet's own API lists this address: Gauntlet USDC Prime v2, morpho_v2, curator 0x9E33faAE38ff641094fa68c65c2cE600b3410585, the same as `curator` read on chain
text.zh-TW: Gauntlet 自己的 API 列出這個地址：Gauntlet USDC Prime v2，morpho_v2，curator 0x9E33faAE38ff641094fa68c65c2cE600b3410585，跟鏈上 `curator` 讀到的一樣
